title: Econometrics REITInflationPanel

stats.done_summary: Completed REIT-Inflation association analysis. Key findings: Strong positive correlation (r=0.931, p<0.001) between inflation and REIT returns; R²=86.6% variance explained; relationship is contemporaneous with no Granger causality. Generated comprehensive report with 7 figures, discussing implications for portfolio management (REITs as inflation hedge) and policy (monetary policy transmission to real estate markets).
